name: Craftsman CMXGSAMY426S
blurb: Oregon prints one chain for CMXGSAMY426S and 172.345460: 16″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 57 drive links (S57).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Craftsman CMXGSAMY426S and 172.345460 on one line with chain S57: 16″ bar, 57 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. 57 links is what the guide prints. It is not the 56-link loop on the CMECS600 / S160 line. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S57 under CMXGSAMY426S and 172.345460: 16″ bar, 57 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
